responsibility: Implements lowering of Rust statements and block-scope item declarations from AST into HIR::Stmt nodes. It dispatches AST statement forms such as expression statements, let bindings, empty statements, extern blocks, macro-rules definitions, and item declarations that are valid in statement position, delegating to the item, expression, pattern, and type lowerers as needed, tracking whether the lowered statement terminates control flow, and inserting the resulting statement and location mappings into the global HIR tables. This file is the executable statement-level bridge used by block lowering to turn sequential AST block contents into HIR statement lists.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of the statement lowerer pair: it defines `ASTLoweringStmt::translate` and the per-statement visitor methods that build HIR statements, delegate statement-position items to item lowering, and record mappings. The same-stem header only declares the statement-lowering visitor interface.
